assumptions: Every alignment covers the same taxa, named alike.
Parsimony tree lengths from NNI searches stand for the best trees.
limits: A locus evolving at a different rate also fails the test, so a call is a candidate for a tree comparison, never a recombination call.
Cost grows fast with taxa: tens of strains are minutes, sixty are hours.
bio.jane/contract.question: Do some loci of a multi-locus alignment have a different history from the rest (incongruence length difference test)?

description: Ask whether some loci of a multi-locus alignment have a different history from the rest, by the incongruence length difference test (Farris et al. 1994).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alpha.description: false discovery rate at which a locus is called.

correction.description: Benjamini–Hochberg (independent or positively dependent tests) or Benjamini–Yekutieli (any dependence; less power). Values: BH (Benjamini–Hochberg), BY (Benjamini–Yekutieli).

loci.description: the loci: one aligned FASTA file per locus (its records are the taxa), or library document names. Every file must name the same taxa.

permutations.description: random deals of the columns per test. The smallest p is 1 / (permutations + 1), which bounds how small a corrected q can get.

seed.description: seed for the column deals. Each permutation draws from its own stream, so one can be re-run alone. Advanced.

name: discover_tree_incongruence

called.description: the loci called at q ≤ alpha

global.description: the test over every locus at once: D, its null, p

loci.description: per locus: its length, the rest's, D, the permutations' mean D, p, q and whether it is called

nullModel.description: the null and the search, stated with every run
